# Stripe Gotchas

> Known Stripe and Stripe Connect patterns that cause hard-to-debug billing failures.

## Entries

- [Catalog Stripe IDs do not prove Connect account ownership](catalog-ids-do-not-prove-connect-account-ownership.md): Stored product and price IDs can belong to a previous connected account; validate and repair them through the current account, and make customer/subscription retries idempotent. MEDIUM.
